Hello, and thank you for calling Weber Auto Service in Munich. We are open from seven a.m. to six p.m., Monday to Friday. There is a free waiting room with coffee and Wi-Fi. There are six lifts, so the service is fast. Is there a problem with your tires? There is a tire center next door. Thank you, and have a good day.

Hi, I am Klaus Weber, and this is my repair shop. It is not big, but it is busy. There are four mechanics and one manager. There is a big room for spare parts. On Monday there are not many customers, but on Friday there are a lot. My favorite tool is an old wrench. It is from my father.

After the fair, Laura takes Camillo to a repair shop in Munich. There is a small reception at the door. There is a waiting room with free coffee. There are six lifts and many tools. There is a big room for spare parts. Camillo takes photos for his shops in Brazil.
